title: Two senior Reform UK officials step down after undercover report
description: Reform says Dan Jukes and James Orr have left their roles as it launches an investigation into the report.

title: Watch: Moment workers are rescued from Nepal tunnel
description: Rescuers pull two people from a hydropower tunnel more than a week after a massive flash flood devastated the Nepal-China border.

title: Argentine leader threatens to sanction oil firms and reiterates Falklands claim
description: Javier Milei reiterates his country's claim on the British overseas territory, saying the "winds of change" favour it.

title: Controversial Jackdaw gas field set to be approved in weeks, sources say
description: The government is set to give the go-ahead for the gas field off the coast of Aberdeen, the BBC understands.

title: Watch: Tensions flare as judge declines to remove juror in Lindsay Clancy trial
description: The jury now faces a seventh day of deliberations in the triple-murder trial.

title: Girl group Katseye are missing two members, but their tour still dazzles
description: Reduced but resilient, girl group Katseye received a hero's welcome in London.

title: British army told to stop non-essential training exercises to save money
description: Units in the UK not preparing to be deployed have been told to cut back on training exercises due to cost pressures.

title: Transplanted pig kidney works in US man's body for record 271 days
description: A man has lived for a record nine months with a transplanted pig kidney while waiting for a human transplant.

title: I lost my savings after a job interview scam
description: Jobseekers, especially Gen Z, are being targeted with fake, booby-trapped recruitment apps.
